summary: Cardiff Lexington Corp filed an 8-K to disclose a common stock purchase agreement with an institutional investor, allowing the company to sell up to $25 million (increasable to $75 million) of its common stock over 36 months. The investor receives commitment shares valued at $250,000 (or $750,000 if increased). Sales require an effective registration statement and stock price above $0.20. This is a structured equity financing facility, not a transformative event. Routine capital-raising filed under Item 1.01 for a material definitive agreement.
